counterfactual_missing_items: No mention of a midline neck cyst or tract
No evidence of normal thyroid in usual location
decisive_items: Neck ultrasound failed to identify the thyroid gland in its normal pretracheal location
several adjacent 1 cm nodular structures enhanced similarly to thyroid tissue, and no thyroid gland was seen in the usual neck location
response.rationale: R2 is strongly supported by the absence of the thyroid in its normal location and the presence of enhancing nodular structures resembling thyroid tissue at the tongue base, which is pathognomonic for ectopic thyroid. R1 (thyroglossal duct cyst) typically presents as a midline cyst and does not explain the absence of the normal thyroid gland; the imaging findings are more consistent with ectopic thyroid tissue.

rejected.why: Lacks the key finding of absent normal thyroid and the enhancing thyroid-like nodules; a thyroglossal duct cyst would not account for the absence of the thyroid gland in the neck.
